title: artemisia arctica subsp. comata
intro: Artemisia arctica subsp. comata, commonly known as Rocky Mountain sage, is a type of flowering plant in the daisy family. The plant is known for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional herbal medicine to treat a variety of health issues. The health benefits of Rocky Mountain sage include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and relieve symptoms of anxiety and stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects.
